title: Mirrored reference code
description:
A customer's legacy system marks test records with reference codes that read the same forwards and backwards once you ignore punctuation, spaces, and letter case.

Write `is_mirrored(code)` that returns `True` if the code is mirrored under those rules. Only letters and digits count. An input with no letters or digits counts as mirrored.

**Example**

```
is_mirrored("AB-12 21:ba")   # True
is_mirrored("AB-12")         # False
```
hints: Use one index at each end and move them toward each other.
`ch.isalnum()` tells you whether a character counts. Skip the ones that do not.
